products.name: Police and Thief
products.description: After a successful heist, a group of robbers try to cheat themselves off the loot.

products.name: Fetch Quest
products.description: A group of warriors race to reach a gold mine — they must overcome the terrain and each other.

products.name: Your Village People
products.description: A battle to be the last player standing as you combat what your village people throw at you.

products.name: One Chance
products.description: Monopoly meets Lagos Survival. Players are given the slice of surviving in Lagos.

products.name: Ludo
products.description: The classic dice rolling game with the battle of leading your group to a safe zone.

products.name: Dicemo
products.description: A list of quests and 4 dice to roll to fulfil them.

products.name: Durbar Festival Puzzle
products.description: A jigsaw puzzle (500 pieces) — a vivid scene from Nigeria's iconic Durbar festival.

products.name: New Yam Festival Puzzle
products.description: A jigsaw puzzle (500 pieces) celebrating the iconic New Yam Festival.

products.name: Egungun Festival Puzzle
products.description: A jigsaw puzzle (500 pieces) depicting the mystical Egungun masquerade.

products.name: Map of Africa Puzzle
products.description: A jigsaw puzzle of the African continent — educational and challenging.

products.name: Na Lie
products.description: A card discarding bluffing game — can you spot who's lying?

products.name: Insects
products.description: A fun card discarding game using insects as a primer.

products.name: Vuum
products.description: A fast-paced card discarding game matching objects by colour, shape and pattern.

products.name: Fight in the Hive
products.description: A card discarding and race to destination game.

products.name: Balloon Headed Man
products.description: A tabletop fencing game — quick reflexes and sharp moves win the duel.

products.name: Chess
products.description: A classic strategy game of kings, queens, and tactical warfare.

products.name: Tic Tac Toe (Digital)
products.description: A digital version of the classic 'X' and 'O' game.

products.name: Ayo / Mancala
products.description: An ancient African seed picking strategy game — simple rules, deep strategy.

products.name: How Nigerian Are You?
products.description: Charades with a Nigerian backdrop — a hilarious test of cultural knowledge.

products.name: No Gree
products.description: Charades with a Nigerian backdrop — no giving up allowed!

products.name: ISANJA
products.description: A fast guessing board game about Nigeria — test your knowledge of the nation.

products.name: Canta Ball
products.description: Classic Nigerian Tabletop Soccer — flick your way to victory on the pitch.

products.name: Village War
products.description: A card discarding game with a twist — wage war between villages.

products.name: Ase
products.description: A card discarding game about Nigerian gods — invoke divine power to win.

products.name: Whot
products.description: Classic card discard game where players match number to number or shapes.

products.name: Shut the Box
products.description: Dice rolling game where players compete to shut the box — press your luck!

events.title: The Things We Do On Tables
events.description: Our premier tabletop gaming meetup. A night of Catan, Jenga, Chess, and unmatched vibes.

email_logs.subject: Welcome to GamesHut!
email_logs.bodyHtml:
Hello Akinyemi Samuel,

Welcome to GamesHut! Your team captain account has been successfully set up and linked to your activity standing. Enjoy your gaming journey!

questions.q: What is the capital of Nigeria?
questions.explanation: Abuja replaced Lagos as the capital in 1991.

questions.q: In what year did Nigeria gain independence?
questions.explanation: Nigeria gained independence from the UK on October 1, 1960.

questions.q: Which popular Nigerian skit maker is famous for his signature blue shirt, black waistcoat, and hilarious deadpan reactions to trouble?
questions.explanation: Investor Sabinus conquered social media with his iconic blue and black outfit and hilarious unlucky-in-life persona.

questions.q: Which superstar made history as the first African solo artist to headline and sell out London's legendary 20,000-capacity O2 Arena in 2021?
questions.explanation: Starboy Wizkid achieved this massive milestone during his unforgettable Made in Lagos tour.

questions.q: In the Marvel Cinematic Universe, what is the rare, vibration-absorbing metal native exclusively to the fictional kingdom of Wakanda?
questions.explanation: Vibranium powers Wakanda's advanced technology and makes up Captain America's famous shield.

questions.q: Who became the first Nigerian player to win the prestigious Serie A Best Striker award after firing Napoli to the Scudetto in 2023?
questions.explanation: Osimhen scored 26 league goals that historic season while wearing his iconic protective face mask.

questions.q: In George R.R. Martin's universe, what is the name of the colossal fortification of ice and magic built to protect the Seven Kingdoms from threats in the far North?
questions.explanation: The Wall spans 300 miles across the northern border and is manned by the sworn brothers of the Night's Watch.

questions.q: Which popular Nigerian skitmaker and content creator is widely recognized for his signature lawyer character, oversized suit, and dramatic facial expressions?
questions.explanation: Layi Wasabi rose to massive viral fame portraying an eccentric, fast-talking lawyer named 'IGBODAFO'.

questions.q: Which African music artist made history by becoming the first African solo headliner to sell out the iconic 20,000-capacity Madison Square Garden in New York?
questions.explanation: Burna Boy successfully sold out the legendary Madison Square Garden during his 'Love, Damini' tour in April 2022.

questions.q: In the critically acclaimed HBO series Game of Thrones, what is the name of the ancestral sword of House Stark made of Valyrian steel?
questions.explanation: Ice was the massive greatsword of House Stark before it was melted down into two smaller swords by Tywin Lannister.

questions.q: Which Nigerian professional footballer won the prestigious CAF African Player of the Year award in 2023 after an incredible title-winning season in Serie A?
questions.explanation: Victor Osimhen claimed the 2023 CAF award following his historic goal-scoring exploits that led Napoli to their first Scudetto in 33 years.

questions.q: In the Marvel Cinematic Universe, what is the name of the fictional, war-torn Eastern European country where the Avengers accidentally create Ultron?
questions.explanation: The devastation of Sokovia during the Avengers' battle against Ultron directly led to the introduction of the Sokovia Accords in 'Captain America: Civil War'.
